accepted_limitations.statement: A user who has logged on successfully may use cached credentials indefinitely while the workstation is disconnected. Disabling the AD account cannot revoke that offline cached logon.

checks.precondition: Windows is online and configured to use {{dns_domain}} AD DNS.
checks.action: Resolve the AD LDAP and Kerberos service records, then inspect the joined domain.
checks.expected: Both service records resolve and the joined domain is {{dns_domain}}.
checks.pass: The DNS queries succeed and the workstation reports {{netbios_domain}} or {{dns_domain}} as its domain.
checks.failure: Stop domain testing; repair DNS or the domain join before continuing.
checks.evidence: Save command output showing the service records and joined domain.

checks.precondition: Windows is online and {{daily_administrator}} has not previously logged on to this workstation.
checks.action: Log on as {{netbios_domain}}\{{daily_administrator}} and start an elevated terminal.
checks.expected: The domain logon succeeds and elevation grants local workstation administration.
checks.pass: whoami reports {{netbios_domain}}\{{daily_administrator}} and the elevated Administrators membership check succeeds.
checks.failure: Do not add Domain Admins to local Administrators; repair only the daily administrator workstation-role assignment.
checks.evidence: Record whoami and the elevated membership result.

checks.precondition: Windows is online and {{standard_user}} is enabled.
checks.action: Log on as {{netbios_domain}}\{{standard_user}} and attempt an administrator-only elevation.
checks.expected: Interactive logon succeeds, but the account cannot elevate using its own credentials.
checks.pass: whoami reports {{netbios_domain}}\{{standard_user}} and Administrators is absent from enabled groups.
checks.failure: Stop minting; remove unintended group membership before another workstation is deployed.
checks.evidence: Record whoami, group output, and the denied elevation result.

checks.action: Log on using .\{{local_rescue}} and open an elevated terminal.
checks.expected: The local account works without AD and has local administrator rights.
checks.pass: whoami names the local computer and the Administrators membership check succeeds.
checks.failure: Do not release the workstation; repair the break-glass account offline.
checks.evidence: Record the disconnected state, whoami, and group result without recording the password.

checks.precondition: {{standard_user}} has completed one successful online logon and logoff.
checks.action: Disconnect all network interfaces and log on again as {{netbios_domain}}\{{standard_user}}.
checks.expected: Cached domain logon succeeds; domain and NAS services remain unavailable.
checks.pass: The desktop opens offline and no network dependency delays or prevents logon.
checks.failure: Repair cached-logon policy before treating the laptop as portable.
checks.evidence: Record the disconnected state, successful desktop logon, and current identity.

checks.precondition: Arch is online and configured to use AD DNS.
checks.action: Resolve AD service records and query {{standard_user}} through the system identity service.
checks.expected: LDAP and Kerberos records resolve and the AD user is returned.
checks.pass: Both DNS queries and the identity lookup succeed.
checks.failure: Stop login testing; repair DNS, time synchronization, Kerberos, or SSSD.

checks.precondition: Arch is online and {{daily_administrator}} has not previously logged on to this workstation.
checks.action: Log on as {{daily_administrator}}@{{dns_domain}} and run a permitted command through sudo.
checks.expected: The domain logon succeeds and the daily administrator has workstation sudo authority.
checks.pass: id identifies the domain account and sudo -v succeeds.
checks.failure: Do not grant broad domain administration; repair only the workstation sudo policy.
checks.evidence: Record id output and the sudo verification result.

checks.precondition: Arch is online and {{standard_user}} is enabled.
checks.action: Log on as {{standard_user}}@{{dns_domain}} and test sudo authorization.
checks.expected: Interactive logon succeeds, but sudo authorization is denied.
checks.pass: id identifies the domain account and sudo -n true fails.
checks.failure: Stop minting; remove unintended sudo or administrative group membership.
checks.evidence: Record id output and the denied sudo result.

checks.action: Log on as {{local_rescue}} and verify sudo authority.
checks.expected: The local account works without AD and has local sudo rights.
checks.pass: getent identifies a local account and sudo -v succeeds.
checks.failure: Do not release the workstation; repair the break-glass account offline.
checks.evidence: Record the disconnected state and results without recording the password.

checks.precondition: {{standard_user}} has completed one successful online logon and logoff.
checks.action: Disconnect all network interfaces and log on again as {{standard_user}}@{{dns_domain}}.
checks.expected: Cached SSSD logon succeeds; domain and NAS services remain unavailable.
checks.pass: The session opens offline and no network dependency delays or prevents logon.
checks.failure: Repair SSSD offline-credential policy before treating the laptop as portable.
checks.evidence: Record the disconnected state, successful session, and current identity.

checks.precondition: Optional SMB storage is enabled and {{storage_host}} is reachable and permits this user.
checks.action: Log on and open the mapped personal storage location.
checks.expected: Logon succeeds and the user can create, read, and remove a test file.
checks.pass: The round trip preserves file contents and the test file is removed.
checks.failure: Keep the local profile usable; report storage unavailable without failing logon.
checks.evidence: Record login duration, mapped path, and file round-trip result.

checks.precondition: Optional SMB storage is enabled and {{storage_host}} is deliberately unreachable.
checks.action: Log on and allow the storage mapping attempt to fail.
checks.expected: The local desktop opens promptly and storage is reported unavailable.
checks.pass: Logon succeeds without a blocking retry loop or temporary profile.
checks.failure: Remove the storage dependency from the logon path before release.
checks.evidence: Record login duration and the non-fatal storage error.

checks.precondition: Optional SMB storage is enabled, {{storage_host}} is reachable, and access is deliberately denied.
checks.action: Log on and allow the storage mapping attempt to receive access denied.
checks.expected: The local desktop opens promptly and access denied is reported without repeated credential prompts.
checks.pass: Logon succeeds and no alternate credentials are cached.
checks.failure: Remove the storage dependency or credential prompt from the logon path.
checks.evidence: Record login duration, the denial, and absence of repeated prompts.

checks.precondition: Optional SMB storage is enabled and {{storage_host}} is reachable and permits this user.
checks.action: Log on, access the personal mount, and perform a test-file round trip.
checks.expected: Logon succeeds and the user can create, read, and remove a test file.
checks.pass: The round trip preserves contents and the test file is removed.
checks.failure: Keep the local home usable; report storage unavailable without failing logon.
checks.evidence: Record login duration, mount path, and file round-trip result.

checks.precondition: Optional SMB storage is enabled and {{storage_host}} is deliberately unreachable.
checks.action: Log on and allow the automount attempt to time out.
checks.expected: The local session opens promptly and storage is reported unavailable.
checks.pass: Logon succeeds without a blocking retry loop and the local home remains writable.
checks.failure: Remove the storage dependency from PAM and the home-directory path.
checks.evidence: Record login duration, local-home write result, and non-fatal mount error.

checks.precondition: Optional SMB storage is enabled, {{storage_host}} is reachable, and access is deliberately denied.
checks.action: Log on and allow the automount attempt to receive access denied.
checks.expected: The local session opens promptly and denial is reported without repeated credential prompts.
checks.pass: Logon succeeds, the local home remains writable, and no alternate credentials are cached.
checks.failure: Remove the mount from the login-critical path before release.
checks.evidence: Record login duration, local-home write result, and denial.
